seo.title: Partnerships - Work With BioMath Core
seo.description: Partner with BioMath Core on business development, research collaboration, or clinical integration. Submit an inquiry to explore distribution, co-marketing, and data partnerships.

hero.label: Partnerships
hero.title: Build with BioMath Core
hero.body: We work with clinics, researchers, and organizations that share our focus on preventive health, privacy, and explainable biomathematical guidance.

types.label: Opportunities
types.title: How we collaborate
types.body: Each partnership type has a distinct scope — from distribution to research to clinical integration.

items.title: Business development
items.body: Distribution, co-marketing, and market access for organizations that want to bring BioMath Core to their audience.

items.title: Scientists & researchers
items.body: Collaboration on biomathematical modeling, clinical validation, and published research using structured health data.

items.title: Healthcare professionals
items.body: Integrate the Human Data Model into clinical workflows — with training, support, and patient monitoring tools.

why.label: Why BioMath Core
why.title: What partners gain
why.body: A product grounded in dual-model analysis, user-controlled data, and long-term health context — not isolated reports.

items.title: Growing market
items.body: $350B+ digital health market with rising demand for preventive, explainable guidance.

items.title: Global reach
items.body: Extend your impact through a product built for international privacy and compliance standards.

items.title: Engaged users
items.body: Access to health-conscious members who actively track biomarkers and long-term wellness.

items.title: Dual-model intelligence
items.body: Biomathematical and clinical models working together — a differentiator for partners and patients alike.

programs.label: Ways to take part
programs.title: Three ways to work with us
programs.body: Organizations, members inviting friends, and long-term advocates each start in a different place.

items.title: Partnership inquiry
items.body: For clinics, research groups, and companies that want a formal agreement with BioMath Core.

items.title: Invite a friend
items.body: Members share a personal link. The friend gets a discount and the member earns account credit.

items.title: Ambassador program
items.body: For members who recommend BioMath Core regularly and want higher rewards, tools, and direct support.

form.label: Inquiry
form.title: Contact us
form.body: Tell us about your organization and the kind of partnership you have in mind. We typically respond within two business days.
